lines.gurmukhi: ਗਲਿ ਜੇਵੜੀ ਆਪੇ ਪਾਇਦਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਜਿਉ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਖਿੰਚੈ ਤਿਉ ਜਾਹਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: gal jevaRee aape paaidaa piaaraa jiu prabh khi(n)chai tiu jaahaa ||
lines.translation: The Beloved Himself puts the chains around their necks; as God pulls them, must they go.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਗਰਬੈ ਸੋ ਪਚਸੀ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਜਪਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਭਗਤਿ ਸਮਾਹਾ ॥੪॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: jo garabai so pachasee piaare jap naanak bhagat samaahaa ||4||6||
lines.translation: Whoever harbors pride shall be destroyed, O Beloved; meditating on the Lord, Nanak is absorbed in devotional worship. ||4||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਃ ੪ ਦੁਤੁਕੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sorath mah 4 dutuke ||
lines.translation: Sorat'h, Fourth Mehl, Dho-Thukay:

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਜਨਮ ਵਿਛੁੜੇ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਕਰਮ ਕਰੈ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: anik janam vichhuRe dukh paaiaa manamukh karam karai aha(n)kaaree ||
lines.translation: Separated from the Lord for countless lifetimes, the self-willed manmukh suffers in pain, engaged in acts of egotism.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧੂ ਪਰਸਤ ਹੀ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਗੋਬਿਦ ਸਰਣਿ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: saadhoo parasat hee prabh paaiaa gobid saran tumaaree ||1||
lines.translation: Beholding the Holy Saint, I found God; O Lord of the Universe, I seek Your Sanctuary. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੋਬਿਦ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਗੀ ਅਤਿ ਪਿਆਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: gobid preet lagee at piaaree ||
lines.translation: The Love of God is very dear to me.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਸਤਸੰਗ ਭਏ ਸਾਧੂ ਜਨ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਮੁਰਾਰੀ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: jab satasa(n)g bhae saadhoo jan hiradai miliaa saa(n)t muraaree || rahaau ||
lines.translation: When I joined the Sat Sangat, the Company of the Holy People, the Lord, the embodiment of peace, came into my heart. ||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਗੁਪਤੁ ਵਸਹਿ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਤੇਰਾ ਭਾਉ ਨ ਬੁਝਹਿ ਗਵਾਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: too hiradai gupat vasahi din raatee teraa bhaau na bujhahi gavaaree ||
lines.translation: You dwell, hidden, within my heart day and night, Lord; but the poor fools do not understand Your Love.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਿਆ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਗੁਣ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: satigur purakh miliaa prabh pragatiaa gun gaavai gun veechaaree ||2||
lines.translation: Meeting with the Almighty True Guru, God was revealed to me; I sing His Glorious Praises, and reflect upon His Glories. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸੁ ਭਇਆ ਸਾਤਿ ਆਈ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਬੁਧਿ ਨਿਵਾਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh pragaas bhaiaa saat aaee duramat budh nivaaree ||
lines.translation: As Gurmukh, I have become enlightened; peace has come, and evil-mindedness has been dispelled from my mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਤਮ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਚੀਨਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਪੁਰਖ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: aatam braham cheen sukh paaiaa satasa(n)gat purakh tumaaree ||3||
lines.translation: Understanding the relationship of the individual soul with God, I have found peace, in Your Sat Sangat, Your True Congregation, O Lord. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੁਰਖੈ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਭਈ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: purakhai purakh miliaa gur paaiaa jin kau kirapaa bhaee tumaaree ||
lines.translation: Those who are blessed by Your Kind Mercy, meet the Almighty Lord, and find the Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਅਤੁਲੁ ਸਹਜ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਜਾਗਤੁ ਰਹੈ ਬਨਵਾਰੀ ॥੪॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: naanak atul sahaj sukh paaiaa anadin jaagat rahai banavaaree ||4||7||
lines.translation: Nanak has found the immeasurable, celestial peace; night and day, he remains awake to the Lord, the Master of the Forest of the Universe. ||4||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
lines.transliteration: sorath mahalaa 4 ||
lines.translation: Sorat'h, Fourth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਅੰਤਰੁ ਮਨੁ ਬੇਧਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਰਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: har siu preet a(n)tar man bedhiaa har bin rahan na jaaee ||
lines.translation: The inner depths of my mind are pierced by love for the Lord; I cannot live without the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਮਛੁਲੀ ਬਿਨੁ ਨੀਰੈ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਤਿਉ ਨਾਮੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: jiu machhulee bin neerai binasai tiu naamai bin mar jaaee ||1||
lines.translation: Just as the fish dies without water, I die without the Lord's Name. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਜਲੁ ਦੇਵਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: mere prabh kirapaa jal devahu har naaee ||
lines.translation: O my God, please bless me with the water of Your Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੰਗਾ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਨਾਮੇ ਹੀ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: hau a(n)tar naam ma(n)gaa din raatee naame hee saa(n)t paaee || rahaau ||
lines.translation: I beg for Your Name, deep within myself, day and night; through the Name, I find peace. ||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਚਾਤ੍ਰਿਕੁ ਜਲ ਬਿਨੁ ਬਿਲਲਾਵੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਜਲ ਪਿਆਸ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jiu chaatrik jal bin bilalaavai bin jal piaas na jaaee ||
lines.translation: The song-bird cries out for lack of water - without water, its thirst cannot be quenched.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਲੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਸੁਖ ਸਹਜੇ ਹਰਿਆ ਭਾਇ ਸੁਭਾਈ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh jal paavai sukh sahaje hariaa bhaai subhaaee ||2||
lines.translation: The Gurmukh obtains the water of celestial bliss, and is rejuvenated, blossoming forth through the blessed Love of the Lord. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਭੂਖੇ ਦਹ ਦਿਸ ਡੋਲਹਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: manamukh bhookhe dah dis dolahi bin naavai dukh paaee ||
lines.translation: The self-willed manmukhs are hungry, wandering around in the ten directions; without the Name, they suffer in pain.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨਮਿ ਮਰੈ ਫਿਰਿ ਜੋਨੀ ਆਵੈ ਦਰਗਹਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਜਾਈ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: janam marai phir jonee aavai daragahi milai sajaaee ||3||
lines.translation: They are born, only to die, and enter into reincarnation again; in the Court of the Lord, they are punished. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਹਿ ਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: kripaa karahi taa har gun gaavah har ras a(n)tar paaee ||
lines.translation: But if the Lord shows His Mercy, then one comes to sing His Glorious Praises; deep within the nucleus of his own self, he finds the sublime essence of the Lord's elixir.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਭਏ ਹੈ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਸਬਦਿ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥੪॥੮॥
lines.transliteration: naanak deen daiaal bhae hai trisanaa sabad bujhaaee ||4||8||
lines.translation: The Lord has become Merciful to meek Nanak, and through the Word of the Shabad, his desires are quenched. ||4||8||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਪੰਚਪਦਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: sorath mahalaa 4 pa(n)chapadaa ||
lines.translation: Sorat'h, Fourth Mehl, Panch-Padhay:

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਚਰੁ ਚਰੈ ਤਾ ਸਿਧਿ ਹੋਈ ਸਿਧੀ ਤੇ ਬੁਧਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: achar charai taa sidh hoee sidhee te budh paaee ||
lines.translation: If one eats the uneatable, then he becomes a Siddha, a being of perfect spirituality; through this perfection, he obtains wisdom.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਕੇ ਸਰ ਲਾਗੇ ਤਨ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਤਾ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਕਾਟਿਆ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: prem ke sar laage tan bheetar taa bhram kaatiaa jaaee ||1||
lines.translation: When the arrow of the Lord's Love pierces his body, then his doubt is eradicated. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਬਿਦ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਦੇਹਿ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: mere gobid apune jan kau dehi vadiaaee ||
lines.translation: O my Lord of the Universe, please bless Your humble servant with glory.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਰਗਾਸਹੁ ਸਦਾ ਰਹਹੁ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramat raam naam paragaasahu sadaa rahahu saranaaee || rahaau ||
lines.translation: Under Guru's Instructions, enlighten me with the Lord's Name, that I may dwell forever in Your Sanctuary. ||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਸਭੁ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣਾ ਮਨ ਮੂਰਖ ਚੇਤਿ ਅਜਾਣਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: ihu sa(n)saar sabh aavan jaanaa man moorakh chet ajaanaa ||
lines.translation: This whole world is engrossed in coming and going; O my foolish and ignorant mind, be mindful of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਹੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲਹੁ ਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਣਾ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: har jeeu kripaa karahu gur melahu taa har naam samaanaa ||2||
lines.translation: O Dear Lord, please, take pity upon me, and unite me with the Guru, that I may merge in the Lord's Name. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਕੀ ਵਥੁ ਸੋਈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਦੇਇ ਸੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: jis kee vath soee prabh jaanai jis no dei s paae ||
lines.translation: Only one who has it knows God; he alone has it, to whom God has given it

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਸਤੁ ਅਨੂਪ ਅਤਿ ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਏ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: vasat anoop at agam agochar gur pooraa alakh lakhaae ||3||
lines.translation: - so very beautiful, unapproachable and unfathomable. Through the Perfect Guru, the unknowable is known. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਇਹ ਚਾਖੀ ਸੋਈ ਜਾਣੈ ਗੂੰਗੇ ਕੀ ਮਿਠਿਆਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jin ih chaakhee soee jaanai goo(n)ge kee mithiaaee ||
lines.translation: Only one who tastes it knows it, like the mute, who tastes the sweet candy, but cannot speak of it.
